Recall the difference formula for sine:

$$
\operatorname{sin}⁡(u-v)=\operatorname{sin}⁡u\operatorname{cos}⁡v-\operatorname{cos}⁡u\operatorname{sin}⁡v
$$

Applying the difference formula for sine with $u=x$ and $v={180}^{∘},$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{sin}⁡(x-{180}^{∘}) & =\operatorname{sin}⁡x\operatorname{cos}⁡{180}^{∘}-\operatorname{cos}⁡x\operatorname{sin}⁡{180}^{∘} \\  & =\operatorname{sin}⁡x\cdot (-1)-\operatorname{cos}⁡x\cdot (0) \\  & =-\operatorname{sin}⁡x.\end{aligned}
$$
